# Imperial Cleaning Inc

> Construction cleanup and post-construction cleaning for commercial contractors and builders in Idaho and Utah. Recurring commercial cleaning is our secondary service.

Based in Idaho Falls, ID 83402. Phone: (208) 520-3202. Email: service@imperialcleaninginc.com.
Business address: 2653 Clarence Pl, Idaho Falls, ID 83402.
Office hours, Mountain Time: Monday-Friday 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM; Saturday 9:00 AM - 1:00 PM; Sunday closed.
Contact the team to confirm the project scope, location, access and schedule. Service-area pages describe coverage, not separate staffed offices.
